title: Binance Dubai Launches Direct AED Deposits & Withdrawals — Earn Up to 450 AED in Rewards
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Dubai has officially launched direct AED deposits and withdrawals for users in the UAE, making it easier than ever to move between your bank account and crypto. This marks a major step forward in simplifying access to digital assets in the UAE, giving users a faster, more seamless, and cost-efficient way to get started. A Simpler Way to Access Crypto in the UAE With this launch, eligible users can now: Deposit AED directly from your UAE bank account into Binance Dubai; Convert your AED into crypto in just a few taps; Trade instantly across Binance Dubai products; Withdraw AED back to your bank account whenever you need. Key benefits: 0 deposit fees Fixed 10 AED withdrawal fee Direct, secure transfers between your UAE bank account and Binance Dubai No workarounds. No unnecessary steps. Just a straightforward experience designed for users in the UAE. For more information please refer to our  Deposit FAQ  and our  Withdrawal FAQ . Promotion: Earn Up to 450 AED in Rewards Activity Period:  2026-06-02 06:00 (UTC) to 2026-07-02 23:59 (UTC) To celebrate the launch of direct AED deposits and withdrawals, new and existing eligible users can complete simple tasks to unlock rewards as they progress. New Users  During the Activity Period,  new to Binance Dubai users*  can complete the following tasks to earn up to 450 AED in total rewards. Task 1: Deposit AED Deposit 100 AED or more from your UAE bank account. Reward: 100 AED Task 2: Trade with Convert Complete a Convert trade of 300 AED or more. Reward: 80 AED Task 3: Refer Friends Refer friends who complete their first trade. Reward: 50 AED per referral, up to 3 referrals Maximum Reward: 150 AED Bonus: Complete All Core Tasks Complete the deposit, trade, and referral tasks during the campaign period. Bonus Reward: 120 AED Note:  *New Binance Dubai users refer to users who register a Binance Account and complete identity verification on the locally regulated exchange prior to 2026-06-02 06:00 (UTC).  Existing Users During the Activity Period, eligible existing users who already have a Binance Dubai account but have not traded in at least 6 months or more can unlock up to 400 AED. Task 1: Deposit AED Deposit 300 AED or more from your UAE bank account. Reward: 50 AED Task 2: Trade on Spot Complete eligible Spot trading volume to receive the respective rewards: Trade 1,000 AED or more.  Reward: 30 AED Trade 5,000 AED or more. Reward: 50 AED Trade 10,000 AED or more. Reward: 80 AED Task 3: Refer Friends Refer friends who complete their first trade. Reward: 50 AED per referral, up to 3 referrals per user. Maximum Reward: 150 AED Bonus: Complete All Core Tasks Complete all the aforementioned deposit, trade, and referral tasks (Tasks 1 to 3) during the Activity Period. Reward: 120 AED Please note:  Rewards are distributed in USDT token vouchers equivalent to the AED reward value.  Rewards are only granted after verified actions, including deposit and trade completion.  Each reward is claimable once per user unless stated otherwise for referrals. Participation and rewards are distributed on a first-come, first-served basis and subject to capped allocations.  How to Get Started Log in or register for a Binance Dubai account. Complete identity verification. Visit the campaign page and click “Join Campaign”. Complete the aforementioned tasks during the Activity Period: Deposit AED via bank transfer; Trade using Convert or Spot; Refer friends to Binance. Track your progress and unlock rewards as you complete each step. Join Here Terms and Conditions: Only  regular and VIP 1 - 3 Binance Dubai users  who  complete identity verification  and  click "Join Campaign" on the  Activity page  during the Activity Period, will be eligible for rewards from the overall prize pool. Eligible Spot trading pairs include all available trading pairs on Binance Exchange, except  BTC/TUSD, BTC/ARS, BNB/FDUSD, stablecoin-to-stablecoin, BUSD trading pairs, and   0 fee pairs . Only trades on eligible trading pairs will count toward the calculation of users’ total trading volume during the Activity Period.  Binance will combine sub-accounts' trading volume with the master account’s standard trading volume in the final calculation. Each sub-account will  not  be viewed as an independent account when participating in this Activity. Binance reserves the right to cancel or amend any Activity or Activity Rules at its sole discretion. These terms and conditions (“Activity Terms”) govern your participation in this activity (“Activity”). By participating in this Activity, users agree to these Activity Terms, and the following additional terms: (a)  Binance Terms and Conditions for Prize Promotions  (b)  Binance Terms of Use ; and (c)  Binance Privacy Policy ; all of which are incorporated by reference into these terms and conditions.  In the case of any inconsistency or conflict between these Activity Terms, and any other incorporated terms, the provisions of these Activity Terms shall prevail, followed by the following in this order of precedence, and to the extent of such conflict: (a)  Binance Terms and Conditions for Prize Promotions  (b)  Binance Terms of Use ; and (c)  Binance Privacy Policy .  Reward Distribution: Rewards are distributed in USDT token vouchers equivalent to the AED reward value. USDT Token voucher rewards will be distributed after the Activities end by  2026-08-02 .   Users will be able to log in and redeem them via Account >  Rewards Hub . The validity period for the token voucher is set at  30 days  from the day of distribution.  Learn how to redeem a voucher . Binance reserves the right to disqualify a user’s reward eligibility if the account is involved in any dishonest behavior (e.g., wash trading, illegally bulk account registrations/logins, self dealing, or market manipulation). Binance further reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. Binance reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to determine the denomination in which a token will be paid. Binance reserves the right at any time in its sole and absolute discretion to determine and/or amend or vary these Activity Terms without prior notice, including but not limited to canceling, extending, terminating or suspending this Activity, its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the timing of any act to be done, and all users shall be bound by these amendments.
